meta.name: aeon
meta.description: This skill should be used for time series machine learning tasks including classification, regression, clustering, forecasting, anomaly detection, segmentation, and similarity search. Use when working with temporal data, sequential patterns, or time-indexed observations requiring specialized algorithms beyond standard ML approaches. Particularly suited for univariate and multivariate time series analysis with scikit-learn compatible APIs.

copy.tagline: 对时间序列数据进行机器学习分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果处理带有时间索引的数据并需要专门的时序算法
copy.tagline_en: Perform machine learning analysis on time series data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with time-indexed data and need specialized time series algorithms

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以使用 aeon 工具包对时间序列数据进行机器学习，包括分类、回归、聚类、预测、异常检测等任务，并生成对应的 Python 代码。
howto.when: 当你需要处理时间序列数据，例如进行分类、预测或异常检测时，Claude 会自动调用 aeon 工具包的相关功能。

say.note: Claude会加载数据并训练分类器，返回准确率。

say.text: 用ARIMA模型预测接下来5个时间点的值。
say.note: Claude会使用aeon的ARIMA进行多步预测。

say.text: 检测这段时间序列中的异常点。
say.note: Claude会使用STOMP算法输出异常分数。

howto.what_en: Installing this skill enables Claude to use the aeon toolkit for time series machine learning tasks, including classification, regression, clustering, forecasting, anomaly detection, segmentation, similarity search, and generating corresponding Python code.
howto.when_en: When you need to work with time series data, such as classification, forecasting, or anomaly detection, Claude will automatically leverage the aeon toolkit's capabilities.

say_en.text: Classify the GunPoint dataset using RocketClassifier.
say_en.note: Claude will load data, train, and return accuracy.

say_en.text: Forecast the next 5 time steps using ARIMA.
say_en.note: Claude will use aeon's ARIMA for multi-step forecasting.

say_en.text: Detect anomalies in this time series.
say_en.note: Claude will apply STOMP and output anomaly scores.
